name: Mahou Senshi Sweet Knights 2 ~Metzer Hanran~
original_name: 魔法戦士スイートナイツ2～メッツァー叛乱～
source:
Finally recognizing the danger posed by Metzer and his ambitions to their continued existence, both Queen Gloria and the Zerou syndicate have taken steps to destroy the male protagonist and his minions, also freeing the captive Sweet Knights in the process.
But although defeated and on the run, Metzer is not dead yet, and while the forces of Good and Evil are locked in the last phases of their war for supremacy, Metzer starts collecting new (dubious) allies and (brainwashed) minions in a personal bid to seize the rule of two worlds for himself in the final battle, where only the strongest (and the cruelest... ) will survive.
